Package com.uk.tsl.rfid.asciiprotocol.enumerations.storm

Class TagReports

java.lang.Object
com.uk.tsl.rfid.asciiprotocol.enumerations.storm.TagReports
public class TagReports extends Object
Bitwise flags to control reporting during inventories e.g. TagReports.EPC | TagReports.RSSI | TagReports.SUMMARY
